# Draft:Kingsley Advani

Kingsley Advani is a technology entrepreneur and venture capitalist. He is the founder and chief executive officer of Allocations, a platform focused on fund management and investment infrastructure. He is also chairman of Advani Family Office and has been involved in early-stage investments in technology companies.
Career
Advani has been active in the venture capital and technology sectors, focusing on early-stage investments and startup development.
He is the founder and chief executive officer of Allocations, a platform that provides tools for fund administration and investment management. He also founded AllocationsX, a secondary marketplace related to private investments.
In addition to his entrepreneurial work, Advani serves as chairman of Advani Family Office, through which he has participated in investment activities across multiple sectors.
He is also a partner at Chainfund Capital, where he has been involved in investments in blockchain and technology-related ventures.
Investment activity
Advani has participated in early-stage investments in technology companies, including ventures in sectors such as fintech, blockchain and artificial intelligence. His investment activity spans a range of startups and emerging technology companies.
Media and public engagement
Advani has appeared in financial and technology media, where he has discussed topics related to venture capital, startups and emerging technologies.
